findings.finding: Every remembered descendant becomes an active required root, and NoSuchProcess/PID reuse retires it without a parent wait witness. The existing registry proves recorded absence, not clean child completion.
findings.evidence: Actual worker57825 was discovered, not explicitlyRegistered; it was root-eligible before the last two frames and later marked ABSENT. No launch/exitcode evidence identifies that worker in this trace.

findings.finding: Registration is conditional on not already being known. A concurrent monitor can remember a direct child first and suppress the explicit launch record. Shared active/known/registered state is not protected by a common lock.
findings.evidence: register() writes explicitlyRegistered only if key not in self.known; remember() can insert that same key.

findings.finding: Popen -> create_time -> register has a birth/identity race; a very short child can exit or be observed by the other monitor before identity registration is complete.
findings.evidence: Both direct launch sites call Popen before fetching create_time and do not hold capture-coordination ownership through registration.

findings.finding: The direct launch sites are not the full spawn closure. Block Git preflight occurs before its registry; shared binding functions spawn Git; renderer launcher invokes a nested Godot wrapper and sandbox/Godot; observer lsof is a further finite process.
findings.evidence: A parent sequence census can see these descendants even if a block-local registry has not started or only registered the long-lived flow/renderer launchers.

findings.finding: Missing one root clears the derived whole membership. The later reparent predicate then labels unchanged controllers as reparented.
findings.evidence: Raw last before/after preserve55469->55463 and57792->55469 with identical createTime. The after root57825 is absent, membership fallback is empty, and the raw FAIL labels are retained but are not proof of physical reparenting.

findings.finding: Fixed-phase sampling finishes before complete per-phase raw revalidation. That creates O(sample_count) work on the critical handoff path.
findings.evidence: Receipt phase boundary gap is3.6311725030245725seconds > frozen3. Cause attribution to replay is plausible source inference; the old trace has no per-operation handoff breakdown.

preserveHistoricalBytes: all old policies/plans/raw traces/refusal and audit packets
minimalVersioning.runtimeDispatch: Explicit new plan/policy path only; add versioned v3 runtime functions or plan-gated dispatch without reinterpreting old v1/v2 inputs. Never monkey-patch v2 globals.
minimalVersioning.reuseBoundary: Reuse source-bound bulk parser, daemon/listener/API rules and exact native-collector witness from v2. New v3 must expose its own module hash plus all inherited dependency/native hashes in Q3/B3/policy. Do not broaden native selfRSS exception.
minimalVersioning.beforeQualEngineeringGate: All actual spawn routes and both monitors must produce replayable finite-child evidence in meaningful bounded engineering controls before freezing a qualification attempt. Unknown spawn coverage blocks readiness.

leaseModel.identity: Canonical (pid,createTimeMicros), plus leaseId/runId/parent identity; compatible floats may be exported but cannot replace exact matching.

examples: block controller during its explicitly active stage
persistentController.rule: Required from identity-bound stage registration until documented stage completion and exact owner wait/release for child controllers. Missing/reused/unreadable while active is adverse. The outer live controller is not auto-retired.

examples: renderer launcher and its Godot wrapper chain
lsof/support subprocess when observed inside an owned execution forest
finiteTask.rule: Must have a source-bound actual launch lease and same direct parent reap/wait result. Completed bulk absence is only absence evidence; finite completion requires the exit witness and all required child closure. Present-frame resource evidence remains mandatory.
finiteTask.successfulRecordedExit: Actual direct-parent wait/poll returncode0, matching PID/createTime lease, valid event order and all descendant closure; no claim of hardware certification or human verification.

discoveredDescendant.rule: Record identity/ancestry in a historical observed ledger and include its live RSS when owned; do not silently make it a persistent controller or authorize it. Unleased/missing-exit descendants remain adverse until an exact source-bound launch/wait chain resolves them.

leaseModel.observerInstrumentBoundary: The already exact native helper witness remains version-bound and self-only. Other helper processes receive finite provenance, not a general exemption. Idle research ownedRoots/ownedProcesses remain empty; instrumentation provenance does not authorize a research/model process.

proposedInterfaces.spawn_finite: spawn_finite(command_spec,parent_lease,stage_id) -> managed handle with ready identity handshake; preserve exact executable/argv behavior
proposedInterfaces.record_wait: reap(managed_handle) -> event with actual returncode, same launch lease, owner identity and wait clock; record before heavy receipt replay
proposedInterfaces.discover: remember_observed(snapshot) -> discovered identities only; never substitutes for direct register
proposedInterfaces.view: lease_view(sample_start,sample_end) -> persistent roots, managed finite states, discovered unresolved identities and exact journal prefix/hash
proposedInterfaces.observe: observe(policy,owned_roots=persistent_roots,lifecycle_evidence=lease_view) -> PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN plus complete raw frames, typed closure and nullable full RSS
proposedInterfaces.audit: validate_observation_v3(policy,observation,lifecycle_journal) and validate_lifecycle_archive -> replay evidence/state/RSS, not a claimed PASS field

requiredExitFields: actual wait/poll returncode (integer; unknown is null)
wait source bound to the same Popen handle
ordered event sequence and previous-record hash
launchEvidenceAndConcurrency.registration: Always append direct-launch evidence even if discovery already saw the identity; deduplicate only by the exact lease event. Use an in-process state lock and an APFS project-local cross-process journal/capture coordination protocol.
launchEvidenceAndConcurrency.birthRace: A child-ready handshake (or a proven equivalent capture-coordinated managed spawn) holds a fast task until PID/createTime and parent ownership are established. No PID-only fallback. Wrapper may exec the exact command to retain identity where appropriate; any remaining nested spawn must itself be covered.
launchEvidenceAndConcurrency.captureCoordination: Prevent a native census from seeing a managed birth before its lease is published. Do not serialize away or hide actual exits. Exit evidence must be available without waiting on a lock held by a capture that needs that very evidence; define/test one lock order and fixed timeouts.
launchEvidenceAndConcurrency.appendJournal: Append-only source-bound per-run event chain with explicit writer/controller identity and monotonic ordering; preserve complete bytes for independent replay. Do not claim cryptographic OS attestation: trust remains the frozen collector implementation and actual recorded wait path.
launchEvidenceAndConcurrency.resourceLimit: If an identity is present in a raw census but RSS identity/read is unknown, the full aggregate is null/adverse even if an exitcode0 event later appears. Last-known RSS, zero-fill and generic selfRSS are prohibited.
launchEvidenceAndConcurrency.unobservedExit: Absent graph identity with no exact wait record is unresolved; a grace period or another favorable census is not a substitute. No arbitrary delay/retry to obtain a passing state.

closureSemantics.missingMember: Retain proven stable members only for diagnosis. Incomplete coverage keeps ownedRssBytes null and overall status adverse; it cannot become partial PASS.
closureSemantics.trueReparent: Emit a proven reparent/ownership escape only when complete relevant identity/ancestry evidence establishes it. When membership cannot be evaluated, emit OWNERSHIP_CLOSURE_UNKNOWN rather than deriving reparent from members=set().
closureSemantics.rssDedup: Deduplicate identities within the outer owned family and do not sum parent sequence and nested block RSS totals as independent processes.

spawnCoverage.route: block and shared Git preflight before registry creation
spawnCoverage.requirement: Introduce lifecycle context before any measured spawn, or prospectively precompute deterministic Git/repository/build preflight before the fixed phases while preserving equal source/input/actual-binary checks and verifying the frozen artifact at use. A precomputed result cannot bypass changed-byte/head checks.
Persistent-stage controller lease vs finite task lease declared explicitly; exact direct-parent launch and reap events, including cancellation/cleanup status.

New source-bound compatibility launcher/wrapper can instrument lifecycle without editing historical renderer snapshots; preserve exact loaded binaries/args and source/build provenance. Any uncovered nested process blocks qualification.
Keep native self witness narrow. Account for lsof and cross-monitor observation; never exempt allother/short processes or silently swallow unknown RSS.
Inventory every subprocess in the measured/cleanup lifetime and source-bind its wait result; shared Docker/VM daemons remain shared and are neither adopted as owned nor killed.

phaseHandoff.design: Validate each saved raw sample online within the fixed two-second cadence; maintain constant-time aggregates and rolling log identity. Move complete revalidation to the independent post-terminal audit. Preserve the actual monotonic scheduling state across phases and keep observation active during receipt/launch work.
phaseHandoff.failure: A slow validator/write/startup causing any late sample, phase overrun, boundary gap or cross-phase raw-sample gap refuses immediately; do not backdate events, drop the slow sample, stretch the window or repeat.
phaseHandoff.independentReplay: The final audit still replays all raw process/API/lifecycle evidence and recomputes phase/cross-phase coverage, population and resources; online flags never replace raw replay.

controls.case: A declared persistent controller remains present with the exact PID/createTime/parent identity through both frames; finite child has identity-bound launch, valid present-frame RSS, exact direct-parent zero wait result, then complete-batch absence. Only that finite lease closes.
Persistent controller missing or reused while REQUIRED_ACTIVE refuses. No wait0, absent graph row, cleanup receipt or manual lease release can waive missing stage-end authority.

Discovered finite descendant disappears with no direct-parent exitcode/wait witness: mark ABSENT_EXIT_STATUS_UNKNOWN, keep scientific/qualification acceptance false. Complete census absence is not NORMAL_EXIT.
Valid child wait0 but its present native row has NoSuchProcess/AccessDenied/unknown RSS: whole owned aggregate remains UNKNOWN/null; never fill zero, last RSS, or native-collector selfRSS.
Child exits before PID/createTime handshake completes; even wait0 cannot repair the missing identity binding. PID-only launch is rejected.
Monitor discovers a process before the direct launcher calls register; explicit direct-launch event is still recorded exactly once and discovery cannot create authorization.

Two monitors plus concurrent controller launches cause missing, duplicate, truncated, out-of-order, wrong-run, wrong-parent or timestamp-inconsistent journal events; reject instead of accepting a favorable prefix.
One child is missing: valid persistent members remain available only for diagnosis, total coverage is unknown, and unchanged parents receive no fabricated REPARENTED label.
Known descendant changes parent or exits its declared ownership forest while alive; the ledger retains it and rejects true reparent/orphan escape even if its former parent has exited.
Old active PID is reused with different creation time: old identity is adverse/unresolved until its own wait proof; new process never inherits the old lease or RSS permission.

Child has nonzero/signal exit, absent returncode, mismatched Popen lease, wrong writer-parent identity or exit before launch. Record observed outcome without treating it as successful child completion.
Direct parent exits but a known grandchild remains alive, outside the closure or with unknown status; process cleanup cannot pass by only closing the parent lease.
Git, lsof, renderer launcher, godot_local/sandbox/Godot spawn routes omit a managed launch/exit identity: reject. No blanket categoryother, short-lived or observer-tool exemption.
Capture/registration/journal lock timeout or unsafe lock path/owner/mode/symlink, missing child-ready handshake or invalid lease token produces UNKNOWN/STOP; no retry loop or relaxed deadline.
Lifecycle records are mutated/rebound while retained observer frames are unchanged; offline replay must detect impossible state, source/policy/journal hash mismatch or incomplete closure.
Foreign dotnet/Godot, unexpected Ollama descendant/model, nonempty/missing API model list, daemon/listener change and native evidence failures remain rejected exactly as before.
Streaming validation saves every raw sample and validates it within the same frozen phase cadence; phase and cross-phase actual timestamps satisfy original limits without reset.

Slow validation/receipt write/child startup creates a >3second actual cross-stage adjacent-sample or phase-boundary gap, last sample misses a boundary, or completion overruns the fixed phase: reject without moving timestamps, dropping samples or repeating a favorable segment.
A block is launched but no block receipt/journal exists; preserve the frozen20UNKNOWN fallback rather than reclassifying as20unattempted.

An integrity-only receipt, zero model calls, successful cleanup, online per-sample flags or selected passing samples are substituted for complete known-driver qualification: remain NOT_QUALIFIED and40pair heldout NOT_RUN.

executionOrder: Publish the separate prospective lifecycle/continuity plan and verify its remote bytes before implementing or measuring the new research path.
Implement and verify v3, complete actual spawn coverage, deterministic negative controls and bounded instrument engineering according to that plan; preserve every failed engineering attempt.
Freeze Q3, actual B3 binaries/native helper/dependencies, policy/module/journal schemas and immutable known qualification inputs; no fresh cases.
Run only the exact plan-authorized fixed phases and complete known-driver qualification once all preconditions pass; any adverse state terminates without an automatic retry.

Only after a complete independently replayed known qualification, publish the acceptance/implementation-and-construction freeze and construct the already confirmed40pairs/80conditions under the separate fixed input contract. No qualification follows from admission, cleanup or integrity-only controls.

conclusions: direct register must not be suppressed by discovery
managed birth identity handshake/capture coordination required
absence without exact wait code is not normal completion
all nested/helper spawn routes must close
exit0 cannot repair unknown RSS or manufacture reparent

limitations: This is a design recommendation, not an implementation, source freeze, tested protocol or new execution result.
The old record does not identify PID57825 as Git and cannot establish its exact exit status.
The exact lease/journal/lock API names remain proposed until the new plan freezes them; no permission is inferred to start a new window from this report.
